programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po run around in circles in Home Dome. The Noo-Noo joins in and the Teletubbies have fun chasing.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys?

programme.title: Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they uncover the truth?

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan head's son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Godfather of Canton
programme.desc: A docker, Lin Si Hai, accidentally saves Commissioner Cheng who then offers him a position in the police force. Lin is smart and soon rises through the ranks through treachery and corruption, before becoming a gangster.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from "Nine Yang Scriptures" by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: As the names of Chang Cheh and Liu Chia-liang became legendary, all-too-often the name of their equally valued collaborator, Tang Chia, is omitted. That may be, because, unlike the previous pair, the veteran kung-fu choreographer only went on to direct three movies of his own. Of course, that makes this trio all the more special, and this first effort perhaps the most special of all.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy "House of 72 tenants", this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: Murder Plot
programme.desc: Martial artist Shen Lang is in discussions with kung fu experts from the other six sects to plot the downfall of the traitorous Happy King when his fiancee suddenly disrupts them and Shen has to quickly bring her away. As they continue to pursue the Happy King, both Shen and his fiancee accidentally fall into a trap set up by the King.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Masked Avengers
programme.desc: Masked killers are wreaking havoc and instilling terror with their vicious weapons of choice: razor-sharp, gut-shattering tridents. Only three fearless fighters dare investigate, leading to mass murder and magnificent martial arts. Chien Hsiao-hou, future co-star of Yuen Woo-ping's THE TAI-CHI MASTER joins the trio to get tri-pierced.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: Dirty Ho
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot...

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Aptly described by its original title of "Money, Sex And Love", this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her master's Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fan's daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fan's friend along the way.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: Hu seeks to avenge his father who is being killed by the White-Browed Hermit and his gang. However, he fails in his attempt and is saved by Fang Shi Yu, a youth from Shaolin whose parents are also killed by the same villains. They learn and master the advanced Shaolin style kung fu, before Fang leads Hu and the Shaolin fellows to fight the enemies.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him?

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him?

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: Brothers from the Walled City
programme.desc: Two orphaned brothers growing up in Kowloon's Walled City - the place where people are forced to live with indecent businesses of sex, gambling and drugs controlled by triads - take very different life paths. Chin works at a cabaret but keeps away from sins, while Kang is drawn to the sleazy underworld. Are their destinies shaped by the "walls"?

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: A young business man marries a pretty and much sought-after young bride, not knowing that she carries the spirit of a girl raped by her uncle and murdered along with her parents. Justice must be done, and it ain't pretty!

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Liu's disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with his son. Years later, the daughter meets a man with the bandits and is tricked to go against Liu.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword and The Kung-fu Instructor as one of his very best.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes on a job as a night guard. As the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at the abandoned building, only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder happens, and the suspects get killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy over two generations.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters’ best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society’s conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Bunshinsaba: Hoichi the Earless
programme.desc: You Mei brings home an abandoned doll found on the street. Little does she know that it is possessed by an evil spirit which causes the sudden death of her colleague. You Mei seeks help from a ghost hunter who unleashes the pencil spirit to fight against the evil spirit, unfortunately leading to a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter -the sole witness- mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law’s affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother’s death?

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: In Cycle
programme.desc: A seemingly happy couple who loves diving come to a deserted island for a diving vacation, which is part of the husband’s plan to murder his wife. His conspiracy however, is intervened by a series of bizarre events on the island. Can the couple eventually escape from the enigmatic ocean?

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father’s underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau’s economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi’s husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei’s possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Blinky's Day Out
programme.desc: After the events at Gattos Keep Blinky is transformed into a human being and Jim discovers the assassin that is hunting him.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - The Shattered King
programme.desc: While Jim and Toby search for dates to the Spring Dance the team searches for the Second Triumbric Stone in the marshlands of the Quagawumps.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Tchau, Uggos
programme.desc: Our team battles Rafaela’s mind-controlled crowd. They soon discover that Rafaela’s true plan is to steal the spy plane. Tony deduces that Rafaela isn’t doing all of this for the money - she’s doing it for family.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Giant Haboob
programme.desc: Cleve Kelso breaks Rafaela Moreno and a dangerous, cybernetic prisoner named Matsuo Mori from a high-security ice prison. Back in LA, Tony and the crew experience a major shake-up when Echo gets accepted to Ms. Nowhere’s spy training but Tony is rejected. While Tony is grappling with his identity crisis, Echo struggles to survive spy school, and Ms. Nowhere and Gary disappear in a massive North African storm during their hunt for Cleve. Echo must lead the Toretto crew and finish Ms.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Dead End
programme.desc: The team travels to Nihaya, or "The Dead End," in their pursuit of Nowhere’s mission. Unfortunately they run into some of Layla’s spurned former criminal partner Sandocal, who steals the kids’ cars for revenge on Layla. With Frostee, Cisco, and Echo held captive, Tony and Layla drive for Sandocal in a dune buggy race to win back their crew’s freedom.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Dollhouse Defenders
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes masks and capes for her and Pandy, they become the dollhouse defenders and must save the Gabby Cats from Bad Guy CatRat! In the Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Kitty Fairy sings a song about her garden magic!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Mixed-Up Dollhouse
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a snow globe shaped like the dollhouse, she notices the rooms inside are all cattywampus and in the wrong place. After a series of wacky misadventures that result in CatRat becoming a craft version of himself, Gabby figures out they need to fix the dollhouse globe to return everything back to normal.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Game Show
programme.desc: It’s Game Show Day in the dollhouse! Our wily and well-groomed host, CatRat, leads Gabby and Pandy around the dollhouse, where they compete in Gab-ified games, like Tushy Tunes on the "butt xylophone" couch and a cooking competition of Bakey with Cakey. They win tickets and trade them in for prizes at the end.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Pirates
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a pirate treasure map in the shape of the dollhouse (a piece of it has been torn off). This must mean it’s time for a pirate treasure hunt in the dollhouse! Pirate Gabby and Pirate Pandy head out on their journey across the many "lands" of the dollhouse to find the Gabby Cats Treasure!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - MerCat Gets Her Sparkle Back
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes beakers filled with a magical potion, they conjure up an invite for Spa Day at the dollhouse! However, while decorating for MerCat's favorite day of the year, MerCat accidentally loses her color and sparkle. Gabby and Pandy must help her get her sparkle back for the big Spa Day party!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Dandelions
programme.desc: The twins inadvertently ruin Fifi's garden while playing a game. Can they and the other tots make it better before Fifi finds out?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Come And Play Slugsy
programme.desc: Stingo has dispatched Slugsy to steal Fifi's jelly. Slugsy starts to play with the twins and forgets what he set out to do, much to Stingo's wrath!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Mystery In Flowertot Garden
programme.desc: Somebody has been going through the tots' bins every night in Flowertot Garden. The tots turn detective to see if they can discover who the culprit is.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Stingo Cleans Up
programme.desc: Diggly has had enough of the heap of unwanted items next to his compost heap. Stingo decides to "resell" them to the other tots and unwittingly helps everybody out!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - My Fair Bumble
programme.desc: Bumble has been asked to Aunt Tulip's for tea but he is worried that his manners are not up to scratch. He asks the other tots to help him out.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Pineapple Palace Panic
programme.desc: Fifi is supposed to be babysitting Grubby, but she's forgotten! Stingo and Slugsy step in to cover for her, with disastrous results!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Poppy's Big Race
programme.desc: It is the day of the annual Flowertot Race. Poppy is reluctant to enter as she always loses her way. Fifi and Bumble help her train for the big race, but will she win?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Blueberry Hunt
programme.desc: Fifi and Bumble are off to pick all the ripe blueberries off the bush. But when they get there all the berries have disappeared. Who could have taken them?

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia's Fashion Show
programme.desc: After attending a disappointing fashion show with Grandma, Olivia designs some fabulous clothes and is determined to put on her own show. Unfortunately, her models (Ian, Francine and Julian) prove to be more difficult to work with than she'd anticipated. It's up to Olivia to think fast and make the fashion show work!

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Makes A Video
programme.desc: When Father takes an out-of-town business trip, Olivia doesn't want him to miss a thing. She decides to create a video diary, filming her family and classmates' everyday life, which isn't quite as exciting as she'd hoped. So Olivia adds her own touch to the final presentation: a big song and dance finish. Dad is thrilled.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Home Alone
programme.desc: Aggro, Burple and Cutter are left alone in the roost to care for some dragon eggs, but a trio of tricky Slinkwings want those eggs for themselves.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Model Behavior Pillow Fight Club
programme.desc: Satin and Chenille put on a fashion show to impress the trendsetter of Troll VillagePoppy and Branch start a massive villagewide pillow battle to determine who gets the pillow of destiny.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - The Imposter Frenemy
programme.desc: When there is an imposter in Troll Village, Branch and Poppy embark on a man-hunt as to try to keep the Trolls from realizing that anything is offPoppy discovers that Archer Pastry belongs to a group of evil creatures called the Party Crashers

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - A Thuper Hero Thtory
programme.desc: Tip and Oh's plan to save Elrod turns into a battle to save earth from Elrod

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - Friend Like Tip Like Mother, Like Pit Of Fire
programme.desc: Tip meets a surprisingly similar girl which threatens Tip's uniqueness When Tip and Die-Anne refuse to "be like their moms", they end up finding themselves in a dangerous situation

programme.title: Dinotrux Supercharged S3 - Bad Build
programme.desc: When the Dinotruxs own talents are used against them Ty realizes that truxing it up may not always be the best plan

programme.title: Dinotrux S3 - Renegades
programme.desc: On the run from D-Structs and D-Stroy, the Trux devise a plan to build an awesome hideaway so they can lead a rebellion from a safe, secure location.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Somewhere Over the Rainbow
programme.desc: Kelp is swept by an ocean current to the shore of Unicorn Land where he sees a majestic creature on a cliff that looks just like him, but not like his Narwhal family under the sea. Kelp tells his family he’s a unicorn. Kelp returns to Unicorn Land where he meets Pixie and Juniper, who show him around and introduce him to unicorn spark and magic.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Tacos Rainy Day
programme.desc: When Kelp is introduced to crunchy tacos in Unicorn Land, he must use his bubble sparks to bring them back to his family underwater. Kelp’s unicorn friends are going to teach him Swishbee on land. But it rains and the game is called off until Kelp shows them that playing in the water can be even more fun.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Welcome to Pawston \ Ruff Day on the Job
programme.desc: Tag wants to bring her new neighbor, Scooch, to the Party in the Tree. But a series of traffic jams make Tag impatient, and she keeps trying to find different ways to get to the party. Thanks to Tag’s handiness - and one of Lady Lydia’s hats - they make it to the party just in time. \ Pawston’s new canine mail carrier keeps getting chased by dogs, so Tag and Scooch have to help him deliver the mail.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Dark Park Bark Lark \ The Fast and the Curious
programme.desc: Tag and Scooch team up to get all of Scooch's chores done in time for the Barkapellas Bark In the Park In the Dark concert. \ Tag is so excited to join the Sam Whippet’s Race Cadets. programme.desc: Kirsty Nichol feasts her eyes on local Bulgarian art at the Helena Resort in Sunny Beach. She also enjoys jet skiing and some delicious local fare.

programme.title: Best From The Rest - River Rafting In India
programme.desc: We have got the ultimate guide to India’s best white-water rafting spots, whether you’re a rookie or a river-riding pro!

programme.title: City Breaks - Brussels
programme.desc: Exploring Brussels makes Catriona realize that it’s the city where historic meets hip, eccentric meets futuristic and traditional meets cosmopolitan.

programme.title: Mount Kailash - The Journey Within - Mount Kailash 1
programme.desc: While planning to go on the Kailash-Mansarovar Trek, Mohit realizes that the preparation for it is a journey in itself.

programme.title: Xplore Oman - Muscat
programme.desc: From the magnificent Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque to the enchanting Muttrah Souq, Elisha experiences the classic Arabic charms of Oman, in Muscat.

programme.title: Backpack - Imphal 1, India
programme.desc: After witnessing fascinating regional art forms at the Sangai Festival in Imphal, Moeen tries his hand at Thang Ta, a local martial arts form.

programme.title: World Heritage - Cyprus
programme.desc: A tryst with the heritage of Cyprus unravels the stories of one of the oldest civilizations in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Off The Grid - Garo Hills,Meghalaya
programme.desc: Once a year, the Garo hills of Meghalaya come alive with the echoes of drums played by the villagers at the vibrant Hundred Drums Wangala Festival.

programme.title: City Breaks - Jaipur
programme.desc: A quick escape to Jaipur introduces Asmita to the stark contrast in the old and new sides of Rajasthan’s capital city.

programme.title: Mount Kailash - The Journey Within - Mount Kailash 2
programme.desc: On the way to Narayan Ashram in Uttarakhand, from where the trek to Mount Kailash can begin, Mohit encounters a landslide.

programme.title: Xplore Oman - FINS
programme.desc: From the limestone formations of Wadi Bani Khaled to the ocean of dunes at Wahiba Sands, Elisha gets a taste of Oman’s natural heritage.

programme.title: Backpack - Imphal 2, India
programme.desc: From the origin of polo to the traditions of indigenous tribes, Moeen Latif uncovers the stories of Manipur when he visits Imphal.

programme.title: 10 Days Estonia - Tallinn
programme.desc: Marco Biagioli and Erica Melargo experience the fairy-tale charms of the medieval Old Town of Tallinn, the capital of Estonia.

programme.title: Off The Grid - Khasi Hills, Meghalaya
programme.desc: From visiting sacred groves and crossing root bridges to exploring caves, Alex finds herself enchanted by the natural wonders of Meghalaya.

programme.title: City Breaks - Bikaner
programme.desc: From miniature paintings on palace walls to elaborate havelis, Asmita finds out that Bikaner is an art lover’s paradise.

programme.title: Mount Kailash - The Journey Within - Mount Kailash 3
programme.desc: Mohit realizes just what it takes to descend 4444 steps and walk along a furious river to reach the base camp on the trek to Mount Kailash.

programme.title: Xplore Oman - Wadi Bani Khalid
programme.desc: Apart from deserts, Oman also has majestic, rust-colored mountain ranges, which quietly hold the country’s history in them.

programme.title: Backpack - Loktak, Manipur, India
programme.desc: From fascinating floating villages to the world’s only floating national park, Manipur’s Loktak lake is home to an intriguing ecosystem.

programme.title: 10 Days Estonia - Aidu
programme.desc: Through sights such as the Seaplane Harbour Museum and Telliskivi Cretive City, Marco and Erica discover the offbeat side to Tallinn.

programme.title: Off The Grid - Majuli 1, Assam
programme.desc: Majuli, the world’s largest river island is known for many things, one of which is the ancient pottery tradition of Salmora village.

programme.title: City Breaks - Brussels

programme.title: Mount Kailash - The Journey Within - Mount Kailash 4

programme.title: Kissed By The Sea - Valletta, Malta
programme.desc: Tara Sumner loses herself in the ornate Baroque legacy left by the Knights of St. John in Valletta, the capital of Malta.

programme.title: Backpack - Manipur and Myanmar Border, India
programme.desc: Moeen visits some beautiful pagodas in Myanmar, but is in for a shock when on his way back to Manipur, he is stopped by some gun wielding men.

programme.title: 10 Days Estonia - Narva

programme.title: Off The Grid - Majuli 2, Assam

programme.title: 10 Days Estonia - Setomaa
programme.desc: Marco and Erica explore the vitality and eccentricities of Tartu. They also get acquainted with the distinct ways of the Seto community.

programme.title: Kissed By The Sea - Comino, Malta
programme.desc: Azure waters, white sandy beaches, Mediterranean charm and a riveting history make Malta the perfect destination for an island getaway.

programme.title: World Spas - Evason Mai'n, Jordan

programme.title: Off The Grid - Bomdilla, Arunachal pradesh

programme.title: Backpack - Ukhrul and Senapati , India
programme.desc: Moeen finds out the history of local headhunting and the curious ways of the regional tribes at Ukhrul in Manipur.

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP21
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP30
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: The Runner - EP1
programme.desc: Web media editor Ho Ka-yan (Elaine Yiu) encounters track and field coach Yuen Nik (Joel Chan) as she is assigned the task of approaching the Windchasers Club and digging up scandalous dirt. Because of some past regrettable incident, Yuen Nik avoids socializing with other people. But he is getting closer and closer to Ka-yan as he repeatedly mingles with her. Kwok Bui-yee (Tiffany Lau), daughter of tycoon Kwok Wong-po (Ram Chiang), eagerly joins Windchasers as she has some ulterior motive.

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP27
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: Plain Love II - EP24
programme.desc: ‘Fong’s tea’ is regarded as the finest in the trade. However, due to downfall of the family, its successor Yau Wai (Lam Ka Tung) can only earn his living by farming. WAI has two best friends, Hon Ngau (Mak Cheung Ching) and Wing Chun (Li Ka Sing, Dickson). They even become sworn brothers, share both happiness and bitterness._x000D_The three of them work in a huge tea garden of Sung’s family. Wai meets Ngai Mui (Cheung Ho Yee, Maggie) again, a girl from highlands.

programme.title: 生活智多星第1688集

programme.title: 美麗人生壯志高飛第418集
programme.desc: 台視60周年台慶大戲《美麗人生》第五單元《壯志高飛》，以1960年代高雄市旗津島為故事起點，三位最美麗的台灣女人，在台灣最美麗的年代，在最美麗的旗津，悲歡交織而成的美麗人生。數百年前，旗津還沒有一個統一的名稱，島的南端依舊與高雄相連。 而後，為了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名喚『崩隙』的這片沙土挖空了，居民被迫遷移，旗津也因而斷開 了與台灣的連繫，猶如遊子，離開了母親的懷抱。土地會消失，歷史也許會被淡忘，但曾經走過那段艱辛歲月的人們，他們的悲歡離合、笑容與淚水，仍將會轉化為孕育後代子孫的養分，開出燦爛的花朵。這是屬於我們上一代人的故事，也是我們這一代人的故事，是所有在這座島嶼上奮鬥的人們的—《

programme.title: 熱海戀歌第21集
programme.desc: 父母親早逝的英雄，從小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次鄉里衝突，英雄和換帖兄弟添財離家北上，進入溫泉鄉~北投，當起限時專送的機車小弟。在北投，他遇見今生唯一的摯愛秀秀。擁有天生音樂才華的他，最初學習各種樂器只是為了討秀秀歡心，最後卻因此成為名揚北投的「春風」那卡西樂團樂手。可惜兩人純真的戀情，卻遭秀秀的養父所反對，英雄卻不放棄；縱使在得知秀秀已與日本商人白原訂婚之後，英雄仍不死心，繼續穿梭在溫泉鄉崎嶇的巷道與繁華的酒宴間，彈著為秀秀所譜寫的未完成歌曲，無畏地向全世界宣誓，他要傾盡一生的光陰來愛秀秀…。在秀秀與白元的婚禮上，英雄衝到美川閣，想帶秀秀遠走高飛！畢竟深愛著英雄的秀秀，身著婚紗、不顧一切坐上他

programme.desc: 為提倡親子共讀、快樂閱讀，全新打造專屬節目《烤箱讀書會》！日本國際兒童圖書評議會主席松居直先生說：「閱讀應該是一件快樂的事！」。不管大人或小孩，每個人都喜歡做有趣的事，如果能將閱­讀和有趣的事結合在一起，應該就能創造充滿趣味的閱讀經驗，在這個節目當中，將帶領小朋友動手做點心，利用烘焙時間，和他們共讀一本圖畫書，不僅分享故事，還有動聽的詩­歌，讓更多大小朋友透過電視，共同參與這個充滿樂趣又有益身心的閱讀活動。

programme.desc: 駱純美出生在台南的下營，爸爸駱煥宗在下營是個出名的裁縫老師，經常舉辦服裝秀，父親也經營電影院，從小與父親感情甚好的純美，二人就如朋友一般，無話不說，從小就生活在「美的事物」的純美，也間接地感染到美感，父親對於純美的未來從不設限，讓她自由發揮，在父親的支持下與鼓勵下，便讓純美夢想要當一個「藝術家」。 高中聯考時，家中生意失敗，讓一心想要念「藝術系」的純美，放棄夢想，轉念師專，因此展開了她的老師生涯。師專畢業的純美，向孔子立誓自己一定要當一個好老師，但純美用熱情對待學生，把學生留下來課輔，卻讓其他老師嫌惡，要她不要太認真，讓她對「老師」的這個職業，產生了疑問。 為了離家近，純美調到台南的鄉下小

programme.title: 大愛年度劇展-芳草碧連天第26集
programme.desc: 這是台灣三代女性傳承孝順的歷史縮影。 魏家三代女性的心路歷程，從第一代阿罔，在艱困的環境中，沒有失志，奮發面對生活的挑戰，孝順婆婆、支持丈夫及女兒，讓大家都能好好活下去，與人為善，救貧治病，深受四鄰親友敬仰的精神裡，影響著女兒高金英及孫女杏芬杏娟姊妹，他們傳承阿媽的腳步，走過時代洪流，與家人彼此扶持，以孝順回報阿媽和母親。杏芬在美國聽了「渡」的錄音帶把家人都度進慈濟

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第52集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第180集
programme.desc:
什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間、在手術室、在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？
『志為人醫守護愛』帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親、 以病為師的堅持、病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 法譬如水第521集
programme.desc: 當災難成為日常，紛亂的世界迫切需要人心的調和，攜手共度難關。大愛電視特別推出《法譬如水—證嚴上人講述水懺》，透過佛法智慧引領觀眾反思人心與環境的深層連結。證嚴上人以清涼法水滌除心垢，將經典智慧化為實踐指南，讓佛法不再遙不可及，而是化解當下困境的明燈。唯有人心淨化，天地才會和諧。

programme.title: 行動現場第547集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散布各鄉鎮村里，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平台，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: 法譬如水第521集
programme.desc: 當災難成為日常，紛亂的世界迫切需要人心的調和，攜手共度難關。大愛電視特別推出《法譬如水—證嚴上人講述水懺》，透過佛法智慧引領觀眾反思人心與環境的深層連結。證嚴上人以清涼法水滌除心垢，將經典智慧化為實踐指南，讓佛法不再遙不可及，而是化解當下困境的明燈。唯有人心淨化，天地才會和諧。

programme.title: 大愛年度劇展-芳草碧連天第26集
programme.desc: 這是台灣三代女性傳承孝順的歷史縮影。 魏家三代女性的心路歷程，從第一代阿罔，在艱困的環境中，沒有失志，奮發面對生活的挑戰，孝順婆婆、支持丈夫及女兒，讓大家都能好好活下去，與人為善，救貧治病，深受四鄰親友敬仰的精神裡，影響著女兒高金英及孫女杏芬杏娟姊妹，他們傳承阿媽的腳步，走過時代洪流，與家人彼此扶持，以孝順回報阿媽和母親。杏芬在美國聽了「渡」的錄音帶把家人都度進慈濟

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第58集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 仁心慧語第120集

programme.title: 純美時光第16集
programme.desc: 駱純美出生在台南的下營，爸爸駱煥宗在下營是個出名的裁縫老師，經常舉辦服裝秀，父親也經營電影院，從小與父親感情甚好的純美，二人就如朋友一般，無話不說，從小就生活在「美的事物」的純美，也間接地感染到美感，父親對於純美的未來從不設限，讓她自由發揮，在父親的支持下與鼓勵下，便讓純美夢想要當一個「藝術家」。 高中聯考時，家中生意失敗，讓一心想要念「藝術系」的純美，放棄夢想，轉念師專，因此展開了她的老師生涯。師專畢業的純美，向孔子立誓自己一定要當一個好老師，但純美用熱情對待學生，把學生留下來課輔，卻讓其他老師嫌惡，要她不要太認真，讓她對「老師」的這個職業，產生了疑問。 為了離家近，純美調到台南的鄉下小

programme.title: 大愛早安新聞 LIVE
programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：「新聞報導，除了『報』，還要進一步『導』，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史。」，大愛新聞透過SNG、電話連線、數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能。

programme.title: 365日日素第563集
programme.desc: 每天一道素食料理，透過簡單的烹調方式，做出健康美味的蔬食料理。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第52集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 仁心慧語第108集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧來自於內心，由內心啟悟的智慧也最真實。證嚴 上人說：「做該做的事就是智慧，做不該做的事就是愚痴。」十個問題、十個解方，都是言者生命經驗的體現，透過名人的智慧哲理，足以啟迪人心，振聾發瞶，重新思考人生的價值。

programme.title: 蔬果生活誌第29集
programme.desc: 關於「吃」，該怎麼吃得有智慧、吃出健康和營養呢？ 瞭解臺灣不同時節、氣候的豐富物產，透過農人的智慧和汗水，告訴您食材的生命故事，並且體驗背後的價值與感動。

programme.title: 看美善學美善美善劇場第529集
programme.desc: 《多謝款待》由渡邊杏主演，東出昌大、財前直見、原田泰造、木村綠子、近藤正臣等共同出演。該劇講述了主人公芽以子從大正年間直到第二次世界大戰結束的數十年間，以飽含心意的美食支持著身邊的人，並始終堅守對丈夫的愛的故事。

programme.title: 慈濟充滿愛第294集
programme.desc: 紀錄全球慈濟人的善行義舉，讓世界充滿愛的溫暖。

programme.title: 人間菩提
programme.desc: 一年365天，一天15分鐘， 證嚴上人以佛心應世事，結合台灣社會脈動、全球趨勢，從後山看世界。

programme.title: 法譬如水第523集
programme.desc: 當災難成為日常，紛亂的世界迫切需要人心的調和，攜手共度難關。大愛電視特別推出《法譬如水—證嚴上人講述水懺》，透過佛法智慧引領觀眾反思人心與環境的深層連結。證嚴上人以清涼法水滌除心垢，將經典智慧化為實踐指南，讓佛法不再遙不可及，而是化解當下困境的明燈。唯有人心淨化，天地才會和諧。

programme.title: 純美時光第17集
programme.desc: 駱純美出生在台南的下營，爸爸駱煥宗在下營是個出名的裁縫老師，經常舉辦服裝秀，父親也經營電影院，從小與父親感情甚好的純美，二人就如朋友一般，無話不說，從小就生活在「美的事物」的純美，也間接地感染到美感，父親對於純美的未來從不設限，讓她自由發揮，在父親的支持下與鼓勵下，便讓純美夢想要當一個「藝術家」。 高中聯考時，家中生意失敗，讓一心想要念「藝術系」的純美，放棄夢想，轉念師專，因此展開了她的老師生涯。師專畢業的純美，向孔子立誓自己一定要當一個好老師，但純美用熱情對待學生，把學生留下來課輔，卻讓其他老師嫌惡，要她不要太認真，讓她對「老師」的這個職業，產生了疑問。 為了離家近，純美調到台南的鄉下小

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第180集
programme.desc:
什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間、在手術室、在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？
『志為人醫守護愛』帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親、 以病為師的堅持、病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 法譬如水第523集
programme.desc: 當災難成為日常，紛亂的世界迫切需要人心的調和，攜手共度難關。大愛電視特別推出《法譬如水—證嚴上人講述水懺》，透過佛法智慧引領觀眾反思人心與環境的深層連結。證嚴上人以清涼法水滌除心垢，將經典智慧化為實踐指南，讓佛法不再遙不可及，而是化解當下困境的明燈。唯有人心淨化，天地才會和諧。

programme.title: 法譬如水第524集
programme.desc: 當災難成為日常，紛亂的世界迫切需要人心的調和，攜手共度難關。大愛電視特別推出《法譬如水—證嚴上人講述水懺》，透過佛法智慧引領觀眾反思人心與環境的深層連結。證嚴上人以清涼法水滌除心垢，將經典智慧化為實踐指南，讓佛法不再遙不可及，而是化解當下困境的明燈。唯有人心淨化，天地才會和諧。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第56集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大愛學漢醫第218集
programme.desc: 讓世界看懂中醫，打破中醫的框架迷思，發揮預防重於治療的優點，讓台灣走向樂活社會。

programme.title: 人間菩提
programme.desc: 一年365天，一天15分鐘， 證嚴上人以佛心應世事，結合台灣社會脈動、全球趨勢，從後山看世界。

programme.title: 大愛年度劇展-芳草碧連天第28集
programme.desc: 這是台灣三代女性傳承孝順的歷史縮影。 魏家三代女性的心路歷程，從第一代阿罔，在艱困的環境中，沒有失志，奮發面對生活的挑戰，孝順婆婆、支持丈夫及女兒，讓大家都能好好活下去，與人為善，救貧治病，深受四鄰親友敬仰的精神裡，影響著女兒高金英及孫女杏芬杏娟姊妹，他們傳承阿媽的腳步，走過時代洪流，與家人彼此扶持，以孝順回報阿媽和母親。杏芬在美國聽了「渡」的錄音帶把家人都度進慈濟

programme.title: 大愛醫生館第6727集
programme.desc: 不斷汲取新知，已是現代人必備的條件，對於人文精神的掌握，往往顯得貧乏。大愛醫生館藉由醫師專業知識加上俯拾即是的美感經驗與與回歸人文思想的本懷，期望幫助忙碌的現代人多關心自己與周遭人的身心健康，為醫療節目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第612集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第1925集
programme.desc: 大陸尋奇是台灣目前最社教節目之冠不惜巨資的大製作足跡踏遍各現代城市、窮鄉僻壤，深入各民族村落，記錄了外人難得一見的生活情況，以準確的地理、歷史定位，用現代化思維，把中華文化忠實的呈現。 漫遊在浩瀚中國的世外桃源，細賞湖光山色間的粉妝玉琢，帶您跋山涉水遊遍奇峰峻嶺，讓您看盡壯闊山河嘆為觀止。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子第6季:第395集
programme.desc: 本作品是以作者的童年（昭和49年，即1974年）生活為藍本的故事，其中一事一物均充滿著1970年代的懷舊氣息。故事發生的舞台是日本靜岡縣清水市，那是一個不折不扣的美麗港都，是個交通便利、漁產豐富、又與富士山為鄰的好地方。故事圍繞著小丸子以及其家人和同學展開，有關於親情、友誼等，或是一些生活小事，但當中有笑有淚，令人回想起童年的稚氣。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子第5季:第347集

programme.title: 唱歌給你聽第57集
programme.desc: 故事講述一個在台灣北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父親不切實際地為這個家帶來債務、困擾與紛爭。時常失蹤的父親只能由任勞任怨的母親咬牙把這個家支撐下去。多年後四處飄浪的父親癌末回來找長大後的女兒，女兒為了處理父親的臨終把本已瓦解的家庭關係，再次找回分散各地家人，並在父親臨終前相互道歉、和解道別。

programme.title: 三生三世十里桃花第51集
programme.desc: 同名小說改編。青丘九尾狐族女君白淺（楊冪）為四海八荒第一絕色，化名司音拜入戰神墨淵（趙又廷）門下，因而捲入天族與翼族之戰。在墨淵封印東皇鐘七萬年後，白淺代師再次封印東皇鐘而受傷，失去記憶與修為落入凡塵歷劫，卻因此變成凡人素素，與天族太子夜華（趙又廷）歷經三生三世的情緣…

programme.title: 股市貴公子第10集

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第2097集
programme.desc: 大陸尋奇是台灣目前最社教節目之冠不惜巨資的大製作足跡踏遍各現代城市、窮鄉僻壤，深入各民族村落，記錄了外人難得一見的生活情況，以準確的地理、歷史定位，用現代化思維，把中華文化忠實的呈現。 漫遊在浩瀚中國的世外桃源，細賞湖光山色間的粉妝玉琢，帶您跋山涉水遊遍奇峰峻嶺，讓您看盡壯闊山河嘆為觀止。

programme.title: 全民星攻略第1323集
programme.desc: 中視推出懸疑益智實境節目《全民星攻略》！由幽默風趣「慧黠」的《館長》-曾國城，引領明星、名人、網紅，全民進擊「九宮格攻略賽」，過關奪大獎！ 最懸疑緊張的過關氛圍、最詼諧爆笑的「爾虞我詐」 ！最貼近「人生」的智慧題庫！敬請準時一起來挑戰-《全民星攻略》！

programme.title: 中視午間新聞第11集
programme.desc: 「中視午間新聞」每天以最客觀的角度，最專業的主播，為觀眾完整報導上午發生之重大國內外重要新聞，並提供最新股市收盤價格。

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第787集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 股林高手第11集
programme.desc: 獨創勝率極高的〝型態操作〞，以技術分析為主，搭配題材面、籌碼面、財務面交互判斷的一種邏輯分析。能夠更明確的洞悉法人大戶籌碼，並且辨別騙線

programme.title: 股市米琪林第11集

programme.title: 價值型投資第11集
programme.desc: 「價值型投資」：理性投資之道！分享價值型投資策略，探討如何挑選低估股票、估值準則和長期投資觀念，同時了解市場趨勢和企業基本面分析。一場追求穩定長期回報的投資之旅，讓您更具洞察力和投資智慧。

programme.title: 金錢道第11集
programme.desc: 過去的歲月中，正華一直在跟金融市場打交道，如今，半生已過。回顧過往，不少體悟值得跟大家分享。賺錢有方法可循，發財是眾多因素集結的結果，只是對待自己，對待每一位朋友，我認為真心最可貴！讓我們持續前行，繼續聊聊金錢道

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子第6季:第396集
programme.desc: 本作品是以作者的童年（昭和49年，即1974年）生活為藍本的故事，其中一事一物均充滿著1970年代的懷舊氣息。故事發生的舞台是日本靜岡縣清水市，那是一個不折不扣的美麗港都，是個交通便利、漁產豐富、又與富士山為鄰的好地方。故事圍繞著小丸子以及其家人和同學展開，有關於親情、友誼等，或是一些生活小事，但當中有笑有淚，令人回想起童年的稚氣。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子第5季:第346集
programme.desc: 故事的主角是小丸子及其家人和同學，故事內容涵蓋了親情、友誼等主題，以及一些生活中的小事情。這些故事中既有歡笑，也有淚水，讓人回想起童年時的天真無邪。

programme.title: 唱歌給你聽第58集
programme.desc: 故事講述一個在台灣北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父親不切實際地為這個家帶來債務、困擾與紛爭。時常失蹤的父親只能由任勞任怨的母親咬牙把這個家支撐下去。多年後四處飄浪的父親癌末回來找長大後的女兒，女兒為了處理父親的臨終把本已瓦解的家庭關係，再次找回分散各地家人，並在父親臨終前相互道歉、和解道別。

programme.title: 三生三世十里桃花第52集
programme.desc: 同名小說改編。青丘九尾狐族女君白淺（楊冪）為四海八荒第一絕色，化名司音拜入戰神墨淵（趙又廷）門下，因而捲入天族與翼族之戰。在墨淵封印東皇鐘七萬年後，白淺代師再次封印東皇鐘而受傷，失去記憶與修為落入凡塵歷劫，卻因此變成凡人素素，與天族太子夜華（趙又廷）歷經三生三世的情緣…

programme.title: 霹靂靖玄錄第14集
programme.desc: 霹靂封魔妖氛起，靖匡逆鱗繫五璣。 玄禍方興殛心劫，錄異鯤鯩納傳奇。 隨著虛無的力量擴散，神秘的南域亦受影響，風濤十二樓、麒麟閣、一局通神、論劍山莊能人輩出，各顯風采。同時，神秘的禁忌長城、死亡三角洲，隱藏著武林未知的暗潮，神秘的浩劫，軒昂五璣在列的參天鹿幘占雲巾、琴狐，將如何引領風騷，揭開禁忌之秘？ 嶄新劇情，俠影鴻篇，且看五璣論戰，並鱗亂世，血譜一卷風雲史。道鋒龍首，仙影俠蹤，共題兩闋靖玄錄。

programme.title: 護心第34集
programme.desc: 靈龍天曜懷著滿心喜悅準備和廣寒門掌門素影成親，誰知素影另有圖謀，她計畫取龍鱗制一件龍鱗鎧甲，為護她真正所愛之人不傷不死，卻不想天曜拼死在最後一刻將凝聚巨大靈力的護心鱗打出，素影大怒，將天曜的不死之身肢解，封印于大江南北。護心鱗飛躍山河，落入了一心口缺失的棄嬰雁回胸膛，填補了雁回心臟缺失，讓她得以活命。十年後，流浪的雁回被辰星山掌門淩霄收養，納入辰星山成為他的弟子。因識海未開，靈力全無，仍是一星弟子，因此被同門嘲笑。一次偶然的機會，觸發了雁回心口護心鱗的力量，靈龍之火瞬間燒毀了鎖妖塔的結界，塔內的妖族趁機逃跑。淩霄得知後將其趕出辰星山，雁回誤解了師父，覺得道不同不相為謀，便瀟灑下山去永州成找好朋

programme.title: 霹靂靖玄錄第15集
programme.desc: 霹靂封魔妖氛起，靖匡逆鱗繫五璣。 玄禍方興殛心劫，錄異鯤鯩納傳奇。 隨著虛無的力量擴散，神秘的南域亦受影響，風濤十二樓、麒麟閣、一局通神、論劍山莊能人輩出，各顯風采。同時，神秘的禁忌長城、死亡三角洲，隱藏著武林未知的暗潮，神秘的浩劫，軒昂五璣在列的參天鹿幘占雲巾、琴狐，將如何引領風騷，揭開禁忌之秘？ 嶄新劇情，俠影鴻篇，且看五璣論戰，並鱗亂世，血譜一卷風雲史。道鋒龍首，仙影俠蹤，共題兩闋靖玄錄。

programme.title: 我們的島第1345集
programme.desc: 一個一小時的節目，能帶給觀眾什麼，能影響什麼？如果把它只當成一個節目，會感覺短短一小時很短暫，如果把它當成一條出路，會發現力量也可以很強大，一直以來，我們節目的理念就是尋求一種改變的可能性，只要有一個人因為看過報導而改變了，反省也好，感動也好，警惕也好，行動也好，就有可能形塑一種新的環境公民力量，也有可能讓錯誤的政策不再繼續。1998年11月1日「我們的島」節目正式播出，當年台灣的環境還處於大肆開發的年代，在經濟掛帥的氛圍中，「我們的島」為環境發出另一種聲音，至今「我們的島」仍是台灣媒體中，唯一以「環境」為報導主題的新聞性節目，也是公共電視開播以來歷史最久的新聞性節目，這十五年「我們的島」製作

programme.title: 老魏第1集
programme.desc: 老魏的一生，應該可以無常與荒謬一言以蔽之。因為無常，所以才會背叛家庭，後又因此遭誣陷變成了政治犯，進了不見天日的牢籠，讓妻兒命運更陷入坎坷。

programme.title: 一步之遙第1集
programme.desc: 1920 年代的上海，一名騙子密謀透過選美大賽洗錢。不料一位參賽者意外死亡，他也被警方懷疑為殺人兇手。

programme.title: 聽聽看第882集
programme.desc: 公共電視最長壽的節目之一。專門用手語介紹有關身心障礙議題的節目，由兩位聽障主持人以不同的層面和角度，介紹身心障礙朋友溫馨感人的故事。

programme.title: 哈!真相大白了第63集
programme.desc: 真假新聞充斥，我們如何快速分辨真偽？本節目透過策略選擇與即時反應，打造高張力比賽。運用壯闊場景設計，打造通往知識殿堂的階梯，帶來震撼視覺體驗。

programme.title: 看公視說英語第8175集
programme.desc: 公共電視與「大家說英語」雜誌合作，製作「看公視說英語」節目，其每日播出的內容均配合雜誌當日教學，透過影像學習英文，深入淺出，是各個年齡層輕鬆學習英語的最佳教材。

programme.title: 水果冰淇淋第2747集
programme.desc: 單元多，可創造明快的節目節奏！不同的單元，猶如一個個不一樣的抽屜，彼此的區隔明確清楚。 多樣的單元，各有各的教育目標及觀賞樂趣。不一樣的孩子可以找到自己喜歡和認同的單元。幼兒的學習並非邏輯式的。單元式的學習方式，更能符合幼兒的學習與發展。綜合雜誌型態的節目類型，可以針對幼兒做全方位的生活學習。

programme.title: 公視早安新聞第41集
programme.desc: 《公視早安新聞》（Good Morning Taiwan, PTS）是公共電視文化事業基金會新聞部製播的晨間新聞節目，於2016年6月6日開播。本節目開播時，為國英雙語節目，其中前半小時以國語播報、後半小時為以英語播報的《Good Morning Taiwan, PTS》。2017年7月31日起，公視早安新聞改為全程國語播報，而英語新聞改為週一至週五播出的《公視英語新聞》（《PTS English News》）。

programme.title: 公視手語新聞第29集
programme.desc: 公視手語新聞將轉型！擴大對聽障者的服務，將原「公視手語新聞」改版轉型為更具資訊性與生活化的新聞節目「手語資訊站」，用輕鬆方式「看見」生活新聞資訊。另將推出專為聽障朋友量身打造的單元「手語新聞通」，結合新聞小辭典以及每日一手語的特性，透過手語主播以及新聞畫面或字幕說明，正確解釋近日新聞焦點，讓聽障朋友清楚新聞脈絡，也讓觀眾學正確的手語。

programme.title: 公視越南語新聞第29集
programme.desc: 《公視越南語新聞》是一個針對越南語觀眾的新聞節目，提供最新、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題，讓觀眾在母語中深入了解世界各地的時事動態。

programme.title: 公視印尼語新聞第29集
programme.desc: 《公視印尼語新聞》是一個專注於印尼語觀眾的新聞節目，提供最新的印尼本土與國際新聞報導，讓觀眾獲得全球時事、文化和政治等多方面的深入了解與連結。

programme.title: 公視泰語新聞第29集

programme.title: 情人的眼淚第1集

programme.title: 安安的夏天第1集

programme.desc: 小鷗（奚伊鷗）是蘇家最小的媳婦，不幸在進門前後，公公跟老公就相繼掛掉，使她完全不得夫家人心。守寡的小鷗也巴不得不再跟婆家有任何牽連，但天不從人願，命運使她跟婆婆越走越近。一天婆婆邀她回去吃中秋飯，她以為婆婆好意，沒想到是要她簽字放棄丈夫的壽險繼承，而由買保險的婆婆受益。她氣得要劃清界線，結果意外發現夫家的餅舖珍賀齋即將面臨關門的命運，婆婆要北上依靠三子一女度過晚年。小鷗假裝事不關己，卻陸續聽到幾個兒女像詐騙集團一樣訛詐婆婆的養老金，激起她的同情心，想幫婆婆一把。落到無家可歸的彩香急需幫助，但援手來自於這不得她疼的媳婦，她又拉不下臉。經由烘焙師發貴的巧妙牽引，小鷗跟彩香約定不以婆媳關係，而以事業

programme.title: 苦力第25集

programme.title: 風車第1集
programme.desc: 顏教授與妻子雅淑挑李天下，一生引領多少學子走過人生歷程，但是面對自己喪失愛孫的哀痛卻始終走不出來。小衛，一個癡癡等待機會到荷蘭尋母的快遞男孩，生活中沒有目標，只有靠飆車的刺激慰藉自己空虛的夢想渴望。小衛守著母親從荷蘭寄來的風車，顏教授與雅淑守著元元最愛的各式各樣風車，因為這兩端對風車的執愛，在一場意外中，因風車而結識。

programme.title: 紅包第1集
programme.desc: 今年過年，宥廷想用紅包錢買台昂貴的全新電玩，殊不知親戚們都在國外沒有回來，宥廷便偷了媽媽的私房錢，當媽媽認為錢是外籍看護Jenny所偷時，爸爸也擔心媽媽是不是發現自己長期覬覦Jenny的外貌，媽媽從年邁的奶奶房間拿了監視器偷偷放在主臥房，想要證明Jenny是兇手並將她遣送回國，一個家庭的鬧劇就此展開

programme.title: 亞洲第2集
programme.desc: 探索亞洲壯麗的野生景觀，從沙漠到叢林、極地到珊瑚海，展現珍稀動物與城市野生生態，並聚焦保護自然的保育英雄。

programme.title: 公視午間新聞第42集

programme.title: PeoPo公民新聞報第30集

programme.title: 我的婆婆怎麼那麼可愛第28集
programme.desc: 小鷗（奚伊鷗）是蘇家最小的媳婦，不幸在進門前後，公公跟老公就相繼掛掉，使她完全不得夫家人心。守寡的小鷗也巴不得不再跟婆家有任何牽連，但天不從人願，命運使她跟婆婆越走越近。一天婆婆邀她回去吃中秋飯，她以為婆婆好意，沒想到是要她簽字放棄丈夫的壽險繼承，而由買保險的婆婆受益。她氣得要劃清界線，結果意外發現夫家的餅舖珍賀齋即將面臨關門的命運，婆婆要北上依靠三子一女度過晚年。小鷗假裝事不關己，卻陸續聽到幾個兒女像詐騙集團一樣訛詐婆婆的養老金，激起她的同情心，想幫婆婆一把。落到無家可歸的彩香急需幫助，但援手來自於這不得她疼的媳婦，她又拉不下臉。經由烘焙師發貴的巧妙牽引，小鷗跟彩香約定不以婆媳關係，而以事業

programme.title: 苦力第26集
programme.desc: 苦力是指從事勞動工作，以付出勞力來維生的廉價勞工。他們大多在碼頭負責貨物的裝卸、建筑地盤的運輸工作。從中國出發到外國工作的苦力，歷史上稱之為華工。

programme.title: 行走TIT第265集

programme.title: 就是愛運動第28集
programme.desc: 健康是國家繁榮和個人生活的基石，而運動是保持健康的關鍵。因此，公共電視與教育部攜手合作，策劃了一個名為《就是愛運動》的節目。透過每一集的介紹，我們希望讓觀眾更深入了解國內各項體育發展的情況，並培養對運動的熱愛和支持。同時，我們也期望能夠激發觀眾對運動的興趣，並鼓勵他們積極參與運動。

programme.title: 水果冰淇淋第2793集
programme.desc: 單元多，可創造明快的節目節奏！不同的單元，猶如一個個不一樣的抽屜，彼此的區隔明確清楚。 多樣的單元，各有各的教育目標及觀賞樂趣。不一樣的孩子可以找到自己喜歡和認同的單元。幼兒的學習並非邏輯式的。單元式的學習方式，更能符合幼兒的學習與發展。綜合雜誌型態的節目類型，可以針對幼兒做全方位的生活學習。

programme.title: 外鄉女第2集

programme.title: 零日攻擊第10集

programme.desc: 自2005年開播以來，《真情部落格》已訪問數百位生命勇士。當這些勇士面對生命中的困難時，他們選擇依靠對耶穌的信心，勇敢地克服挑戰。這些可愛的基督徒願意與大家分享他們生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是將來自天上的美好福分帶給人們。每一個充滿血淚的生命見證都是令人震撼的轉變，帶來最深刻的真實感。

programme.title: 新舊約縱覽第6集
programme.desc: 大衛‧鮑森牧師，係英國當代之聖經權威教師，篤信聖經為上帝的話語，無誤無謬，故畢生之研經與教學，均以此信念為本。

programme.title: 神選之人第24集
programme.desc: 本劇以精湛的演技與緊湊無冷場的劇情吸引全球觀眾目光，成功掀起追劇熱潮並贏得廣大口碑。透過沉浸式的敘事手法，帶領觀眾走進聖經時代的場景與人物互動，同時呈現一位真實、貼近且富有人性光輝的耶穌，使人們在觀賞故事的過程中獲得全新的理解與感動。

programme.title: ila部落住一晚第2季:第11集
programme.desc: 透過二天一夜的部落生活，感受族人的熱情，分享部落美好的人事物，認識並欣賞原住民各族文化之美，提供觀眾只有原鄉部落才有的深度體驗之旅，真實感受在地生活的幸福與美好。

programme.title: pito pitju mpitu’ 7個為什麼?第1季:第73集
programme.desc: 我們去學校上課囉！ 這一季我們帶著六個動畫人物走進校園，去到教學阿美語、排灣語、泰雅語、布農語還有太魯閣語的五個族群語言的學校，跟著族語老師與小小朋友們一起上課、一起唱歌，呈現俏皮與新穎的族語教學方式。在課堂中認識書寫文字的發音，還有複習每集的主要單字。

programme.title: Kari Snruwan紀時光第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 帶你踏上充滿魅力的蘭嶼島，深入了解雅美（達悟）族獨特的文化傳統。 你知道嗎？當長子誕生，父母與祖父母都必須改名，這不僅是一項命名規則，更是對家族傳承的尊重與延續。節目中，我們將跟隨耆老的腳步，聆聽他們故事傳遞的生活智慧，從出海捕魚到追蹤山豬，學習在大自然中生活的哲理，一起感受隨興自然的島嶼節奏，邀你一同感受島嶼文化的純粹與感動。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第10集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道「南路鷹一萬死九千」這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味。很湊巧的，「生趣」這兩個字，其實這是客語「有趣」的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是「大自然真有趣」。這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿、旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: 大自然生趣第11集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道「南路鷹一萬死九千」這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味。很湊巧的，「生趣」這兩個字，其實這是客語「有趣」的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是「大自然真有趣」。這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿、旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.desc: 阿曼王國是中東藏匿得最好的祕密，位於阿拉伯半島的這一角擁有無與倫比的美景與意想不到的地貌。強勁的風吹拂著這片土地，養育出地球上最豐富的生態系之一，其中住著非比尋常的生物，以及地球上最為罕見的幾種動物，包括阿拉伯海大翅鯨、赤蠵龜及阿拉伯狼，還有其他不可思議的物種，例如阿拉伯變色龍、獰貓與埃及禿鷲。

programme.title: 與班弗格爾一起走進剛果第3集
programme.desc: 在最後一段旅程中，班第一次看到浩瀚的剛果河。這條大河就像一條貿易高速公路，19世紀時，歐洲人利用河流掠奪中非的資源，讓殖民帝國變得更強大，現在剛果河仍是數百萬人的生命泉源。

programme.title: 終極苦旅第4季:第5集
programme.desc: 一起來探索蜿蜒崎嶇的波蘭塔特拉山脈，這裡的山脊高聳，直入天際，彌足珍貴的阿爾卑斯式野外地形雖然佔地面積不大，卻仍擁有令人難以置信的美景路線。

programme.title: 工程大改造第6集
programme.desc: 一同見證一座廢棄的筒倉變成令人嘆為觀止的藝廊，再拜訪一棟隱身於古老城堡的家園。

programme.title: 金礦的賭注-救星佛萊迪第4季:第1集
programme.desc: 佛萊迪和璜來到潔米和克莉絲汀的礦場，目標是協助她們將產量翻倍。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第10季:第14集
programme.desc: 為了尋找不一樣的商品，德魯拜訪不同畛域的資深古董商，包括工廠古董店、古怪室內陳設店和約克夏的古董中心。

programme.title: 倉儲挖寶王第2季:第21集
programme.desc: 艾倫和湯回到家鄉洛杉磯，到高檔倉儲中心參加拍賣會，希望能挖到從昂貴的辦公室家具，或是古董葡萄酒收藏品之類的好東西。

programme.title: 倉儲挖寶王第2季:第22集
programme.desc: 斯坦頓是橘郡汽車與航太製作中心，艾倫和湯到這個地方競標倉庫挖寶，但是有位當地看起來和善可親的大媽，竟然下手很猛地跟他們搶標。

programme.title: 凱文哈特的肌肉車俱樂部第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 為了給喬伊改裝靈感，凱文、喬伊和約翰參加福斯車的車聚。拉奇帶喬伊去找改裝福斯車的好手約翰，要讓喬伊的金龜車能跟得上其他人的車。凱文找大家到歐文代爾甩尾賽道學習和體驗甩尾文化。拉奇替約翰的車更換更大、性能更優異的煞車。喬伊參觀完卡通先生的俱樂部會所後，想仿效卡通先生以引擎蓋裝飾俱樂部會所牆面，搭哈利便車去報廢車場物色引擎蓋。約翰和哈利在俱樂部會所內看汽車拍賣會，眾人對參與汽車拍賣會顯得興致勃勃。於是凱文決定帶大家去亞利桑那州體驗汽車拍賣會。

programme.title: 波蘭邊境護衛隊第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 在本集節目中，海關人員發現一對父子檔似乎在進行走私活動，而有隻狗狗在跨越邊境時引起了顧慮，牠能否順利進入波蘭呢？另外，一位曾經被沒收車輛的走私慣犯再次出現，而他是否已改過自新了？

programme.title: 舊礦區新財路第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 這次的案子是在科羅拉多州申特羅城的小艾塔礦場。申特羅城曾經是淘金熱時期的淘金鎮，現今則是賭城。礦場主人高登夫婦想整修礦場上的木屋，作為給子女與孫子女的家族禮物。可惜礦坑已經封住，尾礦經過試金後毫無價值。好在那裡地點佳，靠近國際機場、賭城、公共獵場，因此艾力克斯和凱文將木屋修繕好後，又替原有的滑索場加蓋樹屋，還在露臺底下增加定向飛靶發射器，讓小艾塔成為適合全家來度假的地方。並且取得連續五年、每年兩個月的出租權利。

programme.title: 金礦的賭注-救星佛萊迪第4季:第1集
programme.desc: 佛萊迪和璜來到潔米和克莉絲汀的礦場，目標是協助她們將產量翻倍。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第10季:第14集
programme.desc: 為了尋找不一樣的商品，德魯拜訪不同畛域的資深古董商，包括工廠古董店、古怪室內陳設店和約克夏的古董中心。

programme.title: 樹屋大師第6季:第5集
programme.desc: 戴若將樹屋連接螺栓送到華盛頓州立大學國際規範委員會授權實驗室測試，透過科學取得具體的數據，指出連接螺栓的負荷力，測試後會產生一份報告，在土木工程學教授丹恩多蘭的指導下，三項測試一一進行，側向測試、抽離測試及重力測試。皮特則前往達拉斯拜訪新婚不久的凱西和蕾莉莎，兩人剛迎接新生兒，而且正在興建新家。主屋屬於地中海式，他們希望樹屋的外觀有所不同，因此想要採用當代風格，俐落的線條，大量的明木、金屬、玻璃及窗戶。

programme.title: 凱文哈特的肌肉車俱樂部第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 塑膠杯男孩搭凱文的私人飛機浩浩蕩蕩前往巴瑞特傑克森汽車拍賣會，體驗另一種汽車圈文化。凱文以75萬美元高價標下令他一見鍾情的1959年科維特敞篷車，為俱樂部寫下歷史新頁。拉奇替喬伊的金龜車換上新引擎。史班克帶喬伊去A方案汽車廠見識汽車包膜，喬伊勸退史班克採用薰衣草紫色的包膜，但是打算請A方案汽車廠替俱樂部會所大門做包膜。史班克受到巴瑞特傑克森汽車拍賣會經驗的激勵，決定舉辦塑膠杯男孩的首次汽車展。他找哈利一起去選場地，兩人聊起和凱文認識的經過。史班克將活動通知發給他常去的夜店和脫衣舞俱樂部，卻沒有通知任何汽車俱樂部，以至於沒有任何人來參加他們的首次車展，令凱文大為光火。

programme.title: 白令海大吸金第13季:第10集
programme.desc: 在阿拉斯加的諾姆，淘金熱仍在延燒。在黃金熱推波助瀾下，許多迫切需要用錢的礦工拚了命，也不顧一切駕駛著破舊的挖泥船，潛進變化莫測的冰冷白令海底，全為了吸金撈一筆。

programme.desc: 德魯普里察是個現代的尋寶人。面對挑剔的客戶和高流通率，擁有英國最大的裝飾藝品回收場，德魯經常前往英國各地尋找被人遺棄的珍寶和古物。德魯喜歡尋寶的刺激，他在缺乏建築美學的地方大肆搜刮，再帶回店裡請他的菁英修復團隊為這些古老珍寶賦予新生

programme.title: 凱文哈特的肌肉車俱樂部第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 凱文為上次車展失敗時自己失控的言行向史班克道歉，並表示俱樂部是一個團隊，大家要互相依靠，又嘉許喬伊對俱樂部做的裝飾、哈利新設計的標誌和伯斯規劃的活動。伯斯的野馬又在路上拋錨，他找拉奇幫忙脫困，決定請拉奇幫忙整修、更換引擎，拉奇還幫他補上遺失的F字母。喬伊帶著拉奇和哈力去看一輛他心心念念的68年奧斯摩比彎刀，車況不錯、價格合裡，於是殺價後買下。凱文帶哈利和約翰到永恆車廠看他交由車廠改裝的五輛老爺車。凱文考慮以後做改裝車生意。約翰與哈利都在改裝第二輛老爺車，有了第一次的經驗，這次更有計畫。兩人去看約翰選定的內裝顏色，又去取訂製的車輪，觀看車輪製作做過程。

programme.title: 翻新中古車第12季:第2集
programme.desc: 這次麥克要找一款最能代表美式粗獷美感的1950年代經典皮卡福特F1。車身塗料雖已全部磨光，麥克卻能看出它的潛力，買下後交由艾德著手重建。

programme.title: 翻新中古車-世界巡迴第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 墨西哥越野金龜 在全英國翻新了上百輛令人驚艷的中古車後，邁克布魯爾和馬克艾維斯普力斯利迎接新的挑戰。他們即將展開環球巡迴冒險，入手、修復、賣出世界上最經典的車子，像是法拉利348、澳洲Holden衝浪車。在這趟史詩級公路之旅中，邁克和艾維斯沉浸在各個國家的汽車文化中，結識不可思議的人物、參與精彩的活動並探尋當地的專業。最重要的是，他們使用翻新中古車的老經驗來拯救每台車，打造可以賣出好價錢的好車

programme.title: 金礦的賭注-救星佛萊迪第4季:第3集
programme.desc: 佛萊迪和璜第一次來到華盛頓州，要協助李維和好友柯瑞解決一個月只產出一盎司半黃金的問題。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第10季:第15集
programme.desc: 德魯拜訪凱黑城堡、瓦索爾賣住宅出清品的業者和赫特福夏的主題車庫尋找出乎意料之外的物件。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人-最讚買賣第4季:第5集
programme.desc: 在本集中，德魯普里察回顧了他與英國優秀收藏家們的相遇，並讓觀眾欣賞他們的驚人收藏品，其中包含充滿傳統遊樂設施的露天遊樂場、有著上千艘模型船的收藏、經典且豐富的各種搖滾樂紀念品、厲害且驚人的鐵路物件等，讓大家大飽眼福。

programme.title: 翻新中古車-世界巡迴第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 墨西哥越野金龜 在全英國翻新了上百輛令人驚艷的中古車後，邁克布魯爾和馬克艾維斯普力斯利迎接新的挑戰。他們即將展開環球巡迴冒險，入手、修復、賣出世界上最經典的車子，像是法拉利348、澳洲Holden衝浪車。在這趟史詩級公路之旅中，邁克和艾維斯沉浸在各個國家的汽車文化中，結識不可思議的人物、參與精彩的活動並探尋當地的專業。最重要的是，他們使用翻新中古車的老經驗來拯救每台車，打造可以賣出好價錢的好車

programme.title: 翻新中古車第12季:第3集
programme.desc: 這次麥克要尋找1950年代末期生產的英國跑車MGA。他從經典車經銷商手中找到一台結構札實的車，以低價成交後，立刻開回工作室請艾德著手翻新。

programme.title: 人體不思議第6季:第4集
programme.desc: 本集介紹三位病患：住在英國美登赫的31歲女性蕾貝卡，罹患週期性嘔吐症，嚴重時會神智不清，導致一年進出醫院80多次。德國的血管外科醫師桑德曼教授認為是她的腹腔動脈受到韌帶擠壓所致，於是為她進行手術。美國17歲少女賈琪出生時即有臉部淋巴腫瘤，導致無法進食和說話。為了能說話，賈琪除了接受語言治療外，也準備動手術切除腫大的舌尖。住在巴西偏遠村落的路易斯身體無法對抗人類乳突病毒，使手腳長出大量的疣，讓他無法行走工作，多虧醫生持續為他加強免疫力，病況才得以減緩。

programme.title: 邪惡枕邊人第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 表面之下，你真的了解與你同床共枕的另一半嗎？事實可能出乎意料。高潮迭起的真實故事，揭開婚姻與誓言背後潛藏的黑暗面，直擊當人們遭到最親密的人背叛時，所引爆的毀滅性後果...

programme.title: 兇殺誘惑第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 世界上有一群人，會唆使身邊的人犯下謀殺罪行，許多案例中，搧風點火的背後指使者，操控深愛他們的人，進而借刀殺人。他們無所不用其極，用愛情、性、金錢，或是赤裸裸的欺騙，來得到他們想要的東西...

programme.title: 義式烹飪大賽第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 眾人來到托斯卡尼一處酒莊，酒莊老闆介紹自家產的幾支葡萄酒，而本集的挑戰就是使用葡萄酒與夏季松露做出三道菜的套餐。

programme.title: 時人雜誌犯罪調查第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 國際精品品牌古馳從製作皮箱起家，獲得許多菁英名流喜愛。然而在光鮮亮麗的商品背後，古馳家族內鬥卻開始失控…第三代繼承人墨里奇奧竟在辦公室大樓遭人暗殺。此命案會是血親所為嗎？義大利警方抽絲剝繭，最後發現幕後主使的真面目，不禁令人唏噓…

programme.title: 此生最美味第10季:第7集
programme.desc: 某些餐點裡其實都藏了關鍵食材，如果少了這一味，可能就會讓人覺得嚐起來非常奇怪。艾爾頓發現加州某間餐廳的肉桂捲在麵團裡加了馬鈴薯，可以讓它在烘烤後口感依然保持濕潤又軟嫩，堪稱是神來一筆的做法。賽門則發現加州某間餐廳的烤羊排，竟然配上了甘草粉和甘草油，這種完全讓人意想不到的組合，卻能去除一般人害怕的羊騷味，而且還能進一步提升甜味，因為甘草裡有神奇的酵素可以發揮作用，最後再配上清爽的沙拉，淋上玫瑰水、萊姆汁和檸檬，夢幻無比的風味讓賽門每次享用，都忍不住要拿起來直接大口吃肉。

programme.title: 此生最美味第10季:第8集
programme.desc: 本集此生最美味要帶大家走進各式食堂，看看七道美食專家推薦的食堂料理之冠。包括挑戰新滋味的創意料理，例如綜合貝果調味冰淇淋三明治；或是無國界料理，猶太無酵餅粉製作起司通心麵；當然還有許多令人垂涎欲滴的獨門功夫薯條、貝果與三明治。全都在本單元正點食堂。

programme.title: 美食的渴求第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 許多人愛吃甜食，但糖卻會給人體帶來危害？美國糖業的黑歷史竟然與奴隸制度有關？

programme.title: 美食的渴求第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 黑人最初被帶到美國務農，但今日越來越多黑人農民出走，他們難以獲得政府補助，而且擁有的農地縮減。在不公平的體制下，他們要如何脫離困境自救？

programme.title: 你、我和我的前任第2季:第7集
programme.desc: 亞利克帶老婆去拍孕婦寫真，但拍到一半卡洛琳身體不適送醫，這下有可能需要更早引產。肯西還在生氣麥特拋下家務帶雀兒喜去酒吧。蘿倫找艾波坐下來促膝長談，坦承了近來隱瞞的一件事。珍妮佛與香泰爾的關係在大夥兒同住之後沒有改善反而惡化，丹妮兒也遲遲無法適應同住生活為夜班工作帶來的困擾。

programme.title: 義式烹飪大賽第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 眾人來到托斯卡尼一處酒莊，酒莊老闆介紹自家產的幾支葡萄酒，而本集的挑戰就是使用葡萄酒與夏季松露做出三道菜的套餐。

programme.title: 到美國結婚去-尋愛再出擊第1季:第14集
programme.desc: 八位曾參與《到美國結婚去》的單身男女，來到墨西哥土魯母這座美麗天堂，再次出擊尋找真愛。他們將與形形色色的單身人士配對，滿懷希望踏上難忘的浪漫之旅，追尋屬於自己的第二次幸福機會。

programme.title: 到國外徵婚去第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 哈洛德跟第二位配對人選米凱拉見面了，幾個小時相處下來，他們都對彼此很有好感，非常合得來。

programme.title: 小氣家族第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 克雷頓家的爸爸東尼節儉成性，老婆快受不了，只好拖他去做心理諮商。

programme.title: 你、我和我的前任第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 肯西與家人有約，麥特跟雀兒喜偷偷去逛婚戒。艾波為羅伊舉辦四十歲慶生派對，兩人氣氛曖昧，蘿倫見狀退場。珍妮佛跟丹妮兒難得去酒吧放鬆，但香泰爾不停打電話關心，讓她們快無法忍受。埃洛荻的手術結束後，遲遲沒有收到德安德烈的消息。

programme.title: 義式烹飪大賽第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 眾人來到托斯卡尼一處酒莊，酒莊老闆介紹自家產的幾支葡萄酒，而本集的挑戰就是使用葡萄酒與夏季松露做出三道菜的套餐。

programme.title: 亞洲好住家第8季:第5集
programme.desc: 和臺灣淵源很深的加州夫妻尤希和西莉亞，趁著丈夫轉換職業跑道時一圓兩人的夢想，搬來臺北展開新生活。

programme.title: 亞洲好住家第8季:第6集
programme.desc: 來自維吉尼亞州的派翠克賣掉車坊，搬到了泰國清邁，想實現自由自在地騎摩托車的夢想。

programme.title: 小氣家族第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 克雷頓家的爸爸東尼節儉成性，老婆快受不了，只好拖他去做心理諮商。

programme.title: 阿賢亞洲好食光第1季:第11集
programme.desc: 阿賢和菲律賓第二代華人盧侹榜一起坐上具有美軍特色的吉普尼，來到菲律賓的烤豬之都拉魯馬區，這裡的烤豬店面林立，每一家店都擁有專屬的烤豬坑窯。

programme.title: 阿賢亞洲好食光第1季:第12集
programme.desc: 阿賢來到印尼品嚐體現文化融合的料理，在印尼人人都吃飯，有米飯便知足，包括特色料理元宵瓏苳糕和椰漿飯等。

programme.title: 迷你屋大夢想第8季:第3集
programme.desc: 吉兒和和賈斯汀菲利普住在俄克拉荷馬州里諾，育有兩個小孩，吉兒提出想要住進迷你屋的想法，這樣就不用大費周章清理維護，可以花更多時間和孩子家人相處。

programme.title: 迷你屋大夢想第8季:第4集
programme.desc: 因醫學院訓練的關係，蘇菲需要經常搬到不同的地方，而她很想要一個屬於自己的家，所以她決定蓋一間4坪大的行動迷你屋。

programme.title: 貝琳大聲說第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 貝琳杜普里Baylen Dupree邁向獨立的旅程繼續展開，她一邊與未婚夫柯林籌備婚禮、參加婚前諮商，一邊探索各種治療妥瑞症的方法，包括海外的特殊療程。柯林則對自己未來職涯舉棋不定，加上貝琳父母保護欲很強，使關係變得格外緊繃。

programme.title: 義式烹飪大賽第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 七名主廚即將見證一名擁有數世紀家庭企業的肉販展示切肉技巧。

programme.title: 我是尚娜雷第2季:第2集
programme.desc: 為了離家獨立，尚娜持續努力在找工作，剛好住家附近的犬宿張貼職缺，於是尚娜決定前往應徵。

programme.title: 腳痛要人命-線上看診第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 新冠肺炎疫情肆虐全球，世界彷彿都靜止下來了，但醫學可不會停下腳步。儘管大家都待在家裡與外界隔離，但腳痛起來簡直要人命，患者更不可能得以隔離疼痛，幸好靠著線上看診，足踝外科醫師依然能與病患取得聯繫，檢查患者的足部病症。葛蘭患有先天性缺趾症，這讓他的腳看起來就像龍蝦的爪子，每踏出一步都讓他痛不欲生，全身各個部位也都在為這樣畸形的足部病症產生代償，不僅髖部會歪斜，膝蓋也會疼痛無比，布萊德醫師建議可以進行足趾併趾化手術，讓他重獲外觀正常的雙足，全身重量也不會施壓在單一位置之上。

programme.title: 腳痛要人命-線上看診第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 新冠肺炎疫情肆虐全球，世界彷彿都靜止下來了，但醫學可不會停下腳步。儘管大家都待在家裡與外界隔離，但腳痛起來簡直要人命，患者更不可能得以隔離疼痛，幸好靠著線上看診，足踝外科醫師依然能與病患取得聯繫，檢查患者的足部病症。艾蜜莉天生罹患脊柱裂，小時候醫生就斷言她將無法行走、奔跑和跳躍，不過她仍在兩歲時學會走路，漸漸跟上同齡孩子的腳步，但後來小腳趾又開始蜷縮到腳底下，每踏出一步都讓她痛不欲生，艾波妮醫師建議截除兩隻小腳趾，好讓負重面恢復平衡。

programme.title: 從裡到外第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 兩位主持人要幫普西拉和麥克夫妻翻修房子，範圍包含前後院、廚房、書房、客廳與餐廳。然而隨著拆除工程進行，暴露出許多意料之外的問題，也代表著額外花費。他們是否能克服一切，為麥克夫妻打造出理想房屋？

programme.desc: 本集節目裡，從沒想過自己可能結婚的私人教練潔西卡因為對婚紗完全沒有想法，以至於試穿每一件都喜歡而挑不到夢幻婚紗，梅莉因為母親罹患絕症，雖然自己沒有對象，也希望跟媽媽體驗母女挑婚紗的感動，蕾莉已經挑好自己喜歡的婚紗，但是媽媽下定決心要把婚紗改到完美境界。

programme.desc: 巴比和吉婭達來到托斯卡尼，這次他們要親自下廚，做出道地的托斯卡尼料理。為此，他們要拜訪乳酪及麵粉製造商，學習這些當地特色食材的製作方式。

programme.title: 你、我和我的前任第2季:第9集
programme.desc: 埃洛荻動完手術後，男友德安德烈竟不見蹤影，兩人一見面就吵架，德安德烈甚至脫口而出不願意擔任繼父的角色；麥特秘密計劃著要向肯西求婚，鬼祟的行徑，加上雀兒喜在家沒大沒小的態度，反而讓肯西內耗又傷神；珍妮佛與丹妮兒去酒吧放風，卻遭到香泰爾不斷來電打擾，引發一場大吵，珍妮佛不禁擔憂起自己接下來該如何是好。

programme.title: 義式烹飪大賽第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 七名主廚即將見證一名擁有數世紀家庭企業的肉販展示切肉技巧。

programme.title: 六千金在我家第5季:第8集
programme.desc: 蜜雪兒想起自己女兒小時候，總是在露營時演戲給自己看，決定安排孫女演出各自爸媽的認識過程，讓大家看了開心又感動。

programme.title: 腳痛要人命-線上看診第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 新冠肺炎疫情肆虐全球，世界彷彿都靜止下來了，但醫學可不會停下腳步。儘管大家都待在家裡與外界隔離，但腳痛起來簡直要人命，患者更不可能得以隔離疼痛，幸好靠著線上看診，足踝外科醫師依然能與病患取得聯繫，檢查患者的足部病症。葛蘭患有先天性缺趾症，這讓他的腳看起來就像龍蝦的爪子，每踏出一步都讓他痛不欲生，全身各個部位也都在為這樣畸形的足部病症產生代償，不僅髖部會歪斜，膝蓋也會疼痛無比，布萊德醫師建議可以進行足趾併趾化手術，讓他重獲外觀正常的雙足，全身重量也不會施壓在單一位置之上。

programme.title: 腳痛要人命-線上看診第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 新冠肺炎疫情肆虐全球，世界彷彿都靜止下來了，但醫學可不會停下腳步。儘管大家都待在家裡與外界隔離，但腳痛起來簡直要人命，患者更不可能得以隔離疼痛，幸好靠著線上看診，足踝外科醫師依然能與病患取得聯繫，檢查患者的足部病症。艾蜜莉天生罹患脊柱裂，小時候醫生就斷言她將無法行走、奔跑和跳躍，不過她仍在兩歲時學會走路，漸漸跟上同齡孩子的腳步，但後來小腳趾又開始蜷縮到腳底下，每踏出一步都讓她痛不欲生，艾波妮醫師建議截除兩隻小腳趾，好讓負重面恢復平衡。

programme.title: 亞洲好住家第8季:第5集
programme.desc: 和臺灣淵源很深的加州夫妻尤希和西莉亞，趁著丈夫轉換職業跑道時一圓兩人的夢想，搬來臺北展開新生活。

programme.title: 亞洲好住家第8季:第6集
programme.desc: 來自維吉尼亞州的派翠克賣掉車坊，搬到了泰國清邁，想實現自由自在地騎摩托車的夢想。

programme.title: 低價醜屋變好宅第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 克莉絲蒂李Cristy Lee協助心灰意冷的購屋族，找出價格令人驚喜的的潛力物件，缺點就是屋況通常滿恐怖的。但只要他們願意相信克莉絲蒂刻劃的願景，她就能把最糟糕的房子改造成他們夢想中的家。

programme.title: 小鎮翻修趣振興全美第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 艾琳和班要為威屯卡市翻修他們的市民廳，還要為熱衷社區服務的羅斯一家翻修房子。

programme.title: 義式烹飪大賽第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 本集節目中，普萊斯頓與柯瑞兩位隊長造訪了一間乳酪廠，並各自選了五種乳酪。

programme.title: 此生最美味第10季:第9集
programme.desc: 本集節目中的特別大餐介紹紐約丹尼爾餐廳的陶封鮭魚佐以茴香和鹽膚木，肯塔基州列星頓的馬龍牛排館的奧斯卡雙份菲力，紐澤西州天堂海灘的究極辣雞翅，喬治亞州亞特蘭大獨木舟的鴨牛雙響堡，紐約州道格拉斯頓的耶爾托斯卡諾做的美味托斯卡諾龍蝦，加州柔似蜜吉榮烤鴨店的北京烤鴨，和聖地牙哥的草木餐廳的牛尾義式麵疙瘩。

programme.title: 此生最美味第10季:第10集
programme.desc: 本集節目介紹的絕對傳奇有紐約市「樂貝爾納丁」的扇貝佐日式高湯榛果奶油醬，華盛頓特區「辣肉醬阿班」的肉醬煙燻香腸堡，堪薩斯市「老喬的堪薩斯市烤肉餐廳」的卡羅萊納豬肉三明治，糖丘「寶莉鬆餅屋」的蕎麥鬆餅，東漢普頓「尼克與東尼」的松露巧克力冰淇淋，紐約市「21俱樂部」的招牌凱薩沙拉，格倫多拉「甜甜圈師傅」的新鮮草莓甜甜圈。

programme.title: 阿賢亞洲好食光第1季:第13集
programme.desc: 越南朋友劉國強騎電單車載著阿賢在胡志明市兜轉，四處可見不少越南攤販售賣華人麵條，其中又以雲吞麵居多，源自中國南方的雲吞麵征服了越南人的味蕾。

programme.title: 阿賢亞洲好食光第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 阿賢很快就發現越南許多當地佳餚帶有華人色彩，並開始比較越南的方粽與中國的粽子。

programme.title: 低價醜屋變好宅第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 克莉絲蒂李Cristy Lee協助心灰意冷的購屋族，找出價格令人驚喜的的潛力物件，缺點就是屋況通常滿恐怖的。但只要他們願意相信克莉絲蒂刻劃的願景，她就能把最糟糕的房子改造成他們夢想中的家。

programme.title: 明星之死第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 艾黛雅從小熱愛表演，她來到好萊塢想一圓明星夢。不料，平時在社群媒體上活躍的她，一日竟然完全與外界斷絕聯絡失去蹤跡。

programme.title: 可愛動物大集合第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 媽媽是世界上最重要的人，我們將透過節目中一些住在野外的媽媽，來了解媽媽的偉大。

programme.title: 可愛動物大集合第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 這個世界充滿可愛的動物，但其中最可愛的可能就是大家家裡常見的小狗。小狗有無窮的精力，對生活有無止盡的渴望，加上那可愛的呆萌模樣，值得登上可愛動物第一名的寶座。

programme.title: 野性拉丁美洲第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 加勒比海地區可謂熱帶海域的天堂，有潮溼的叢林、偉大的河流、以及無人探索的洞穴。這是一個對比鮮明的地區，擁有豐富的生物多樣性和各式各樣的生態系，從熱帶森林到淡水溼地，從鮮豔的珊瑚礁再到神祕的紅樹林，都得接受加勒比海強大威力的統治。

programme.title: 喬治亞水族館第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 館內新進兩隻獲救的加州海獅，喬絲是五歲的母海獅，艾力克斯是六歲的公海獅，美國政府認定無法野放，因為牠們眼部有白內障的問題，若視網膜未剝離，可手術移除白內障，恢復視力，但若不幸視網膜已剝離，就只能摘除眼球，以減輕牠們的痛苦。館內的三隻白鯨，梅寶、努納威和奇努，參與水族館跟加州大學聖克魯茲分校合作的研究案，透過瞭解牠們的新陳代謝幫助野生白鯨。歐菲莉亞是館內展出的北太平洋巨型章魚，牠們是全球體型最大的章魚。

programme.title: 自然怪事求解答第1季:第19集
programme.desc: 佛羅里達州的艾弗格雷茲沼澤裡，許多大白鷺都會站在凶猛鱷魚的背上，甚至會在充滿鱷魚的水域上方築巢。

programme.title: 自然怪事求解答第1季:第20集
programme.desc: 你知道老鼠被搔癢時會笑出聲音嗎？科學家甚至發現牠們還很喜歡被搔癢呢，

programme.title: 寵物好宅第1季:第9集
programme.desc: 寵物已真正成為家中一份子，許多住家迫切需要改裝友善的寵物環境，因此寵物宅室內設計師也應運而生。本集中，設計師安東尼歐巴拉托帶領觀眾參觀許多寵物主人，如何為自己和心愛的寵物設計設計好看又兼具功能的空間，簡直到了無所不用其極的地步。例如有人在自己住家中打造90多公尺長的天橋連接每個房間，讓家中24隻貓能自由生活，沒有壓力。還有人在威斯康辛州的697平方公尺的豪宅內打造了北美洲最大的私人珊瑚礁水族箱。還有加州馬里布愛犬專屬豪華日托和寄宿度假中心，令人嘆為觀止。

programme.title: 可愛動物大集合第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 媽媽是世界上最重要的人，我們將透過節目中一些住在野外的媽媽，來了解媽媽的偉大。

programme.title: 動物軍火庫第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 海象能吐水柱讓海床上的蛤蜊露出來；後頷魚也會口吐沙石挖洞或是嚇阻掠食者；蜜蜂的螫針是重要的防衛武器；水母也擅用螫刺，這些動物都是噴吐螫咬的掠食高手。

programme.title: 史蒂芬弗來會恐龍第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 白堊紀晚期僅出現在北美洲的霸王龍向來是恐龍界的明星，本集就跟著史蒂芬弗來及科學家一同了解霸王龍的食性、運動模式、交配育幼等生活面向。

programme.title: 野性拉丁美洲第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 加勒比海地區可謂熱帶海域的天堂，有潮溼的叢林、偉大的河流、以及無人探索的洞穴。這是一個對比鮮明的地區，擁有豐富的生物多樣性和各式各樣的生態系，從熱帶森林到淡水溼地，從鮮豔的珊瑚礁再到神祕的紅樹林，都得接受加勒比海強大威力的統治。

programme.title: 喬治亞水族館第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 查理和莉莉是喬治亞水族館最老的斑嘴環企鵝，牠們都是三十二歲。非洲野生企鵝的壽命約在十到十五歲之間。因此查理和莉莉的年齡已經遠超過同類的平均壽命。企鵝配偶會終身廝守。查理和莉莉已經在一起約二十五年了。牠們之所以會被當成展示動物，主要是因為查理牠的眼睛不太好，牠罹患了白內障。人們至今仍不清楚企鵝為何會罹患白障，只知道牠們和人一樣，在老年時容易有白內障。工作人員原本計畫帶查理去館外的獸醫院，但查理在麻醉時差點發生意外，因此工作人員只能藉著口服藥和眼藥水緩解牠眼睛的不適。

programme.title: 動物軍火庫第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 不管是單獨使用或合併使用，噴射分泌物和發出氣味是兩種強大的手段，在動物軍火庫裡讓動物可以採用更靈活的策略，以達到防身、驅敵、逃跑和吸引等各種目的。

programme.title: 可愛動物大集合第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 你也許猜得出來貓跟狗是世界上最受歡迎的兩種寵物，但你知道還有很多不可思議的動物也是寵物嗎？

programme.title: 寵物好宅第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 家居設計師安東尼歐巴拉托將寵物融入室內設計，創造出理想的寵物居家環境。這次他受法蘭西絲卡委託，要為他們飼養的澳洲牧羊犬布魯打造全新的後院狗樂園。安東尼歐和全體團隊不僅要解決後院塵土飛揚的問題，更要將餵食區域從廚房轉移到儲藏室。同時，為了因應炎熱的夏季，他們更打造了狗狗專屬的戲水池，以及可以提供乘涼空間的特色狗屋。當然，最重要的壓軸就是讓狗狗們盡情玩耍的溜滑梯。此刻，布魯和牠的狗朋友正等待樂園開幕。

programme.title: 超能動物第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 《超能動物》探索棲息在地球上奇妙又驚人的生物。每一集主題透過震撼的大自然影像、漫畫風格的視覺效果，搭配不可思議的小知識，展現這些不同凡響的動物，巧妙結合自然歷史與流行文化，寓教於樂，適合所有年齡層的觀眾一同觀賞。

programme.title: 喬治亞水族館第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 查理和莉莉是喬治亞水族館最老的斑嘴環企鵝，牠們都是三十二歲。非洲野生企鵝的壽命約在十到十五歲之間。因此查理和莉莉的年齡已經遠超過同類的平均壽命。企鵝配偶會終身廝守。查理和莉莉已經在一起約二十五年了。牠們之所以會被當成展示動物，主要是因為查理牠的眼睛不太好，牠罹患了白內障。人們至今仍不清楚企鵝為何會罹患白障，只知道牠們和人一樣，在老年時容易有白內障。工作人員原本計畫帶查理去館外的獸醫院，但查理在麻醉時差點發生意外，因此工作人員只能藉著口服藥和眼藥水緩解牠眼睛的不適。

programme.title: 寵物好宅第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 家居設計師安東尼歐巴拉托將寵物融入室內設計，創造出理想的寵物居家環境。這次他受法蘭西絲卡委託，要為他們飼養的澳洲牧羊犬布魯打造全新的後院狗樂園。安東尼歐和全體團隊不僅要解決後院塵土飛揚的問題，更要將餵食區域從廚房轉移到儲藏室。同時，為了因應炎熱的夏季，他們更打造了狗狗專屬的戲水池，以及可以提供乘涼空間的特色狗屋。當然，最重要的壓軸就是讓狗狗們盡情玩耍的溜滑梯。此刻，布魯和牠的狗朋友正等待樂園開幕。

programme.title: 喬治亞水族館第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 喬治亞水族館有四隻海獺，這次要迎接從蒙特里灣救援計畫救起的海獺寶寶，館員和海獺寶寶搭飛機抵達亞特蘭大，剛到時先暫時入住隔離區觀察健康狀況。介紹館內的鬼蝠魟，計畫幫其中一隻鬼蝠魟南迪做體檢，動員許多人力，第二次才成功。介紹隔離區的棕硬尾鴨，一段時間後將牠們移動到展示區適應環境。館員餵食館內14隻雪花鴨嘴燕魟。館員細心照料海獺寶寶，注意其飲食及身體狀況，後讓兩隻海獺寶寶互相認識。經過幾週訓練，其中一隻海獺寶寶瑪拉移動到展示區。

programme.title: 滅絕動物大追蹤第1季:第8集

programme.desc: 小鎮村本來是一個平凡的小鎮，可是自從遺傳學家尤教授來到鎮上以後，這個平凡的小鎮就搖身一變成為一個的舉世矚目的地方，尤教授希望可以運用科學方法，創造出世界上最完美的小女孩，他將蜜糖和香料等各種甜美的材料混在一起，不過他不小心將神秘的化學原素X也給加了進去，結果就創造出三個模樣可愛，嫉惡如仇、誓與罪犯周旋到底的飛天小女警。
